outcome: proportion of patients identified in the SCD group
cohort: The study included 497 critically-ill obstetric patients admitted to the high-dependency unit (HDU) of Princess Christian Maternity Hospital PCMH, Freetown, Sierra Leone.
finding: Critically ill obstetric patients with sickle cell disease experienced a four-fold higher crude HDU mortality rate (36%) compared to those without SCD (9.5%), an association that remained significant after accounting for severity on admission.
